description.value: This systematic review examines the relationship between executive functions and clinically meaningful addiction treatment outcomes, focusing on therapeutic adherence and drug relapse in patients with substance use disorders.

spans.text: This systematic review aims to examine growing evidence linking cognitive-executive functions with addiction treatment outcomes, and to discuss significant cognitive predictors drawing upon addiction neuroscience theory.

description.value: A systematic review of empirical studies published in English-language scientific journals, identified through PubMed and PsycInfo, concerning neuropsychological measures of executive functions and treatment adherence or relapse in patients with substance use disorders.

spans.text: A systematic search was conducted to identify studies using neuropsychological measures of executive functions in patients with substance use disorders, for the purpose of predicting relapse or therapeutic adherence.
